title: Clean
summary: Clean is an AI-powered data quality platform that detects ML-specific dataset issues such as label errors, duplicates, outliers, class imbalance, and bias. Its 'Synthetic Data Validator' feature includes a self-implemented GaussianCopulaSynthesizer class that mirrors SDV's tabular synthesizer API and concept without importing the actual SDV library.
evidence: src/clean/synthetic.py:768 'class GaussianCopulaSynthesizer' with fit/sample logic reimplementing SDV's tabular synthesizer name and behavior, no sdv import present
needs: No actual import of the sdv package appears in the evidence; unclear whether GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is an independent reimplementation inspired by SDV's API or coincidental naming.
